images.prompt: Photorealistic head-and-shoulders studio portrait of a humanoid android: clearly a robot, but skinned with realistic, natural human-like skin. Subtle, elegant android tells: thin vertical seam / panel lines on the forehead and temples, fine seam lines along the jawline and running down the sides of the neck, a few tiny inset sensor points near the temples, and a very faint seam where the neck meets the shoulders. The seams are physical, not drawn: very fine recessed hairline grooves in the skin, like precision-fitted panel joins on a premium device, catching a soft shadow on one edge and a faint highlight on the other. Composition: square image, subject centered and facing the camera directly, head and shoulders filling about 70% of the frame, eyes on the upper third line, medium close-up. Background: a plain seamless studio backdrop in soft light warm grey (#EDEBE8), evenly lit, no gradient, no vignette, no props, no text, no logos. The android is woman-presenting, appearing around 30 years old, with warm deep-brown skin, dark brown eyes, and dark natural hair pulled back into a neat low bun, soft and friendly features. She wears a simple modern soft heather-grey knit crew-neck sweater, with a hint of a synthetic collar seam at the base of the neck. Facial expression: a calm, relaxed resting expression with a subtle pleasant warmth, mouth closed, eyes looking directly into the camera.
